note: Przegląd Eid Al Etihad 25.11.2026: brakujące punkty oficjalnego programu Szardży (Sharjah24, 17.11) i Dubaju (WAM, 20.11); Sheikh Zayed Festival przedłużony do 5.12 (WAM, 23.11). Drone show w Dubaju był odrzucony – dodany ponownie z godzinami z WAM.

events.title: Eid Al Etihad at Al Seyouh Family Park
events.description: Sharjah's Eid Al Etihad celebrations at Al Seyouh Family Park: an Emirati Family Village, a Children's Oasis, a youth village, the Souq Ahluna market, interactive programmes and folk troupes.

events.title: Eid Al Etihad at Al Nouf 1 Park
events.description: Interactive programmes, folk troupes and displays by local productive families for Eid Al Etihad at Al Nouf 1 Park in Sharjah.

events.title: Eid Al Etihad at Sharjah National Park and Al Layyah Canal
events.venue: Sharjah National Park and Al Layyah Canal
events.description: National celebrations with competitions and family activities at Sharjah National Park and along Al Layyah Canal.

events.title: Eid Al Etihad at Khor Al Hamriyah Heritage Village
events.venue: Khor Al Hamriyah Heritage Village, Al Hamriyah
events.description: Folk songs, school performances, competitions, workshops, local food and a classic car exhibition in Al Hamriyah; 28 November is dedicated to events for women.

events.title: Fakhr Al Watan – Eid Al Etihad operetta at Khorfakkan Amphitheatre
events.description: The national operetta Fakhr Al Watan with the Al Mazyood harbiya troupe and folk groups, plus a showcase of local family products and an exhibition of works by people of determination.

events.title: Eid Al Etihad at Mleiha Heritage Village
events.description: Community, cultural and heritage events for Eid Al Etihad in Mleiha.

events.title: Eid Al Etihad at Al Batayeh Public Park
events.description: Eid Al Etihad celebrations for the Al Batayeh community, with more activities in Al Barair and Bin Rashid parks.

events.title: Eid Al Etihad at Al Dhaid Fort
events.description: A national parade, patriotic songs, stands by productive families and government entities, workshops and heritage competitions at Al Dhaid Fort.

events.title: Eid Al Etihad at Al Khrouss Park
events.description: A national parade with cultural and heritage activities at Al Khrouss Park in Sharjah.

events.title: Eid Al Etihad Drone Show (1,600 drones)
events.description: 1,600 drones draw the UAE flag and national symbols over the Dubai waterfront for the 55th Eid Al Etihad. Shows at 8 pm and 10 pm on both nights, visible from Bluewaters and The Beach near JBR.

events.title: Al Fursan Eid Al Etihad Airshow at Kite Beach
events.description: The UAE Air Force aerobatic team Al Fursan performs a display over Kite Beach as part of Dubai's Eid Al Etihad programme.

events.title: Eid Al Etihad at Mohammed Bin Rashid Library
events.venue: Mohammed Bin Rashid Library, Al Jaddaf
events.description: Family activities, cultural sessions and traditional Emirati food in the library's outdoor plaza for Eid Al Etihad.

set.description: Five days of Eid Al Etihad celebrations at Sheikh Zayed Festival in Al Wathba: drone shows with 5,000 drones, nightly fireworks, heritage parades, international performances and daily prize draws, with a car giveaway on 2 December.
